description: Within-family mechanism classification, Gerasimavicius dataset, linear probe (gene-split CV within each Pfam family)
note: All families have small sample sizes (6-12 genes). High variance throughout. Directional only — not publishable at single seed.

PF00069.name: Protein kinase
PF00069.note: Both probes at or below chance F1. No signal.

PF00168.name: C2 domain
PF00168.note: WT F1=0.810 looks strong but always-LOF baseline is 0.731 and std=0.234 is very high. Marginal gain over baseline. Not convincing.

PF00046.name: Homeodomain
PF00046.note: Both probes below chance. Delta AUROC=0.498 is essentially random.

PF00071.name: Ras GTPase
PF00071.note: Delta AUROC=0.818 is striking but GOF=92% makes classification near-trivial. DN has only 2 genes — folds are degenerate. Treat with extreme caution.

PF00520.name: Ion channel (voltage-gated)
PF00520.note: Most interpretable result: 2-class GOF vs DN on 9 ion channel genes. Delta clearly better than WT (AUROC 0.659 vs 0.396). Low std (0.050) on delta F1. Directional positive signal for within-family GOF/DN separation.

summary: Within-family signal is present in isolated cases (PF00520 ion channel delta AUROC=0.659, PF00071 Ras delta AUROC=0.818) but sample sizes are too small (6-12 genes per family) for reliable estimation. PF00520 is the most interpretable: 2-class GOF vs DN on 9 ion channel genes, delta F1=0.407 vs WT F1=0.325. All results single-seed only — high variance throughout. Directional finding, not a publishable claim.
